messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "people who are not suitable for surgery"
set: ["people who are not suitable for surgery", "people who are suicidal or prone to addiction", "people with asthma or other breathing problems only when other treatments are not suitable", "plan for surgery", "preparing for surgery", "avoid being near people who are sick or have an infection", "safety not known in people who have had pancreatitis", "most people are told not to eat less potassium", "surgery", "for use in adults and children who are at least 2 years old", "different products are not interchangeable", "adults and children who are at least 6 years old", "not what most people pay", "spinal surgery", "heart surgery", "pancreas surgery"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
